plan: Full experiment design produced in a single Markdown document. Sections: (1) Objective, (2) Dataset parameterization with ESOL default + QM9/ZINC/Tox21/curated-fixture alternatives, (3) Properties (Lipinski-8 + validity flags + derived sanity descriptors), (4) SMILES parsing/validation (regex tokenizer + stack-based parser + 6-rule sanitization gate + deterministic canonicalization), (5) Descriptor computation (MW, HBD/HBA, heavy_atoms, ring_count via hand-rolled SSSR, rotb, Crippen logP per Wildman-Crippen 1999, Ertl TPSA per 2000 paper), (6) Controls (shuffled SMILES negative control with budget ≤5%; atom-sum no-topology baseline; descriptor ablation; determinism check via sha256 re-run), (7) Analysis plan (validity, descriptive stats, distribution-shape flags, Pearson+Spearman correlation matrix, Lipinski pass-rate with bootstrap CI, reference-table sanity), (8) Feasibility & risk register with three named risks + mitigations, (9) Acceptance criteria. Appendix A: embedded 10-molecule reference table (water through ibuprofen) with literature values as acceptance benchmark. Appendix B/C: per-dataset notes and 50-molecule smoke fixture policy. Document explicitly states it is design-only and no experiment was executed.
